description: Trafic de l'Hérault 2023 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Points of measurement scattered on the territory of Hérault, along the departmental roads. They measure the daily passage of vehicles around them to record road traffic on planned routes. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic of the Hérault 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Its keywords include mobilite, trafic, comptage, routes-transports-et-mobilites, infrastructure-routiere. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
